annotations.title: Place or remove a website photo

description: Place an owned Library image (asset_id) in a renderer section and role, or remove it with remove:true. Needs the exact displayed if_unchanged revision, and a description (alt_text) or decorative:true. Free. Without confirm:true it returns a preview only; pass confirm:true only after the owner approves. A lost write reply must be reconciled with soclo_page_get and soclo_page_versions before retrying.

alt_text.description: A description of the photo, required unless it is decorative or removed.

asset_id.description: An owned image from Library, resolved by the server.

confirm.description: true only after the owner approved the exact change. Omit or pass false to get a preview: nothing is sent.

decorative.description: true if the photo is purely decorative (then no description is needed).

if_unchanged.description: Exact displayed site, page-list or History revision, as last read; never refresh it invisibly.

page_id.description: Which page of the site, from soclo_page_pages (or soclo_page_design_get). Omit for the home page — changing a child page without this changes the home page instead.

remove.description: true to remove the image from that section and role instead of placing one.

role.description: The photo slot within the section.

section_id_or_kind.description: The renderer section receiving the image.

name: soclo_page_media_save
title: Place or remove a website photo
